title: Every session repainting full-screen at 30 fps (the worst case)
description: One phase forever: a full-screen SGR-heavy synchronized repaint every frame at 30 fps. Phase boundaries fall on frame boundaries (60 s = 1800 frames), so the cadence never glitches, and every 10 Hz marker tick rides a frame.

provenance.source: Plan D3: the worst case by construction - qontinui-runner#1856's 120x40 full-screen synchronized repaint, every frame, at 30 fps.
